displayName: Ashley Furniture API - Prices, Sale and Regular Price, Reviews, Stores
description: Ashley Furniture API for Ashley sale prices and product data - keyword search (48 per page, exact total, sorted by best sellers, price, newest, rating or name) and category and deal grids (30 per page, filtered by facet or price) with price, Ashley's Regular Price, discount, sale, clearance, doorbuster and hot buy badges, rating, review count and stock; one product by item number or link with every option and variant, set components, dimensions, materials, stock and delivery, the nearest store, the rating histogram, the first 10 reviews, customer photos and Q&A; Black Friday, clearance and Hot Buys deal grids; stores near a point and one store's address, phone and hours. Every US answer says which ZIP and price zone Ashley priced it for. ashleyfurniture.com (USD) plus Ashley's licensed storefronts in Canada, Mexico, the Philippines, Saudi Arabia and Turkey for search and product. 6 endpoints, 2 credits per call on us and mx, 1 on ca, ph, sa and tr.
